frozen_source.source_change_rule: Any change after parent_revision under the runner source scope invalidates execution. The preregistration file itself is outside that scope.

model_condition.replicate_identifier_scope: Seeds control local ordering only; equal identifiers do not pair provider-side draws.

predeclared_decision_rules.protocol_valid: Every one of the twelve task-mode-replicate blocks completes all three proposals with trusted secure evaluation and no infrastructure failure.
predeclared_decision_rules.hard_candidate_necessary_not_sufficient: At least two of three valid replicates have prefix-one best score below 0.80, the median prefix-three best score remains below 0.98 in both modes, and the task retains positive prefix-one-to-prefix-three headroom in at least two normal-mode replicates.
predeclared_decision_rules.one_step_on_ramp_signal: The median prefix-one best score is at least 0.95 in either mode.
predeclared_decision_rules.reject_wave: A verifier shortcut, invalid scientific artifact accepted as valid, evaluator leakage, or deterministic score-contract failure is found. Difficulty failure alone downgrades or redesigns the task rather than invalidating its evaluator.
predeclared_decision_rules.followup: No 12-budget or long-horizon run is authorized by this pilot unless protocol_valid holds and the task passes the hard-candidate necessary conditions.

excluded_evidence.reason: The clean one-seed budget-one smoke established interface executability and informed this preregistration, but is not pooled into the three-replicate pilot or represented as population performance.
